title: Boron Improved High Limiting Oxygen Index Polyelectrolyte Treatment for Cotton
treatment_method: Bleached combed cotton429W approximately100g/m2; cut30.5x12.7cm,10 DI-water passes,dry70C1h.5wt%PEI pH10 primer5min,wring,10DI rinses,wring. Anionic8wt%PSP bath pH7 immersion5min/rinse completes firstBL;6.5wt%PAH pH7 immersion5min/rinse then anionic bath1min/rinse completes secondBL. Subsequent1min PAH/anionic immersions/rinses continue to12BL. Dry70C overnight. This row is baseline non-mechanically-conditioned fabric; three-cycle manual crushing variant held.
